headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nick Gonzales leading the offense. Gonzales hit a home run and finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBI. The Cincinnati Reds also secured a win, defeating the Milwaukee Brewers 7-2 behind Chase Burns' performance. Jose Trevino led the Reds' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs. The Colorado Rockies dominated the Miami Marlins, winning 14-4 behind a strong team effort, while the Cleveland Guardians secured a 6-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox in a thrilling finish.

Several players have been affected by injuries, with Jason Adam of the San Diego Padres placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain. Mitchell Parker of the Washington Nationals has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with left elbow inflammation. Matt Chapman of the San Francisco Giants has been placed on the 10-day injured list with an abdominal strain, while Kris Bubic and Connor Seabold of the Kansas City Royals have been placed on the 60-day and 15-day injured lists, respectively, due to left elbow soreness and a right lat strain. Corey Seager of the Texas Rangers has been placed on the 10-day injured list with lower back inflammation, and Will Vest of the Detroit Tigers has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right posterior elbow inflammation. Connelly Early of the Boston Red Sox has also been placed on the 15-day injured list with left elbow inflammation.

The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz. The Athletics have traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen, while the Texas Rangers have traded C Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Ben Peoples. The Seattle Mariners have acquired 1B Buddy Kennedy from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Brewers 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Chase Burns earning the win. Jose Trevino led the Reds' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Rout Marlins 14-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies dominated the Miami Marlins, winning 14-4 behind a strong team effort. Jake McCarthy led the Rockies' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 6-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Tim Herrin earning the win. Brayan Rocchio led the Guardians' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres' Jason Adam Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: San Diego Padres right-handed pitcher Jason Adam has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain, effective retroactive to June 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Kyle Nicolas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz.
